2608.31142.title: Auditing Anonymous AI Models: A Four-Stage Protocol for Black-Box Identity Verification
2608.31142.paper_summary: The 2025--2026 AI market has seen a wave of stealth releases: frontier models launched anonymously on developer platforms under codenames. For their users, identity determines data-handling terms, supply-chain risk, and capability expectations. No validated methodology exists for black-box identity verification of anonymous models: practitioner checklists lack accuracy evidence, and self-identification is untrustworthy by design. We propose a four-stage forensic audit protocol for API-served models. Stage 0 reconstructs launch-time configuration from archived platform snapshots (Internet Archive), exposing preview--production drift. Stage 1 fingerprints configuration (context, output ceiling, reasoning, modality) against the platform catalog. Stage 2 tests tokenizer identity with a cross-length differential that rejects short-prompt collisions. Stage 3 corroborates with behavioral probes. We test declaration consistency on 10 known-identity releases (7 exact, 2 precision-differences, 1 partial, 0 counter-directional), not end-to-end identification under anonymity. Identification is validated prospectively on a flagship case whose 2026-08-23 analysis pointed to the GLM-5.3 version line and whose official reveal confirmed those family and version-line inferences (deployment variant was not pre-asserted; Flash was consistent post-reveal), and on three Stage-0-only cases where the protocol produced a graded hypothesis or declined rather than guessed. A standard-library-only implementation is provided as supplementary material.
2608.31142.paper_summary_zh: 2025--2026 年的 AI 市場出現了一波隱秘發布：前沿模型在開發者平台上以代號匿名推出。對於它們的用戶來說，身份決定了數據處理條款、供應鏈風險和能力預期。對於匿名模型，並不存在經過驗證的方法論來進行黑箱身份驗證：從業者檢查清單缺乏準確性證據，自我識別因設計而不可靠。我們提出了一個四階段的法醫審計協議，適用於 API 服務的模型。第 0 階段從存檔平台快照（互聯網檔案館）重建啟動時的配置，揭示預覽與生產的偏差。第 1 階段將配置（上下文、輸出上限、推理、模式）與平台目錄進行指紋比對。第 2 階段通過一種跨長度差異測試標記器身份，拒絕短提示碰撞。第 3 階段通過行為探針進行證實。我們對 10 個已知身份的發布進行了聲明一致性測試（7 個精確、2 個精度差異、1 個部分、0 個反向），而不是在匿名下進行端到端識別。識別在一個旗艦案例中前瞻性地得到驗證，該案例的 2026-08-23 分析指向 GLM-5.3 版本線，官方揭示確認了這些家族和版本線的推論（部署變體未事先聲明；揭示後 Flash 一致），以及三個僅第 0 階段的案例，其中協議產生了分級假設或選擇不猜測。標準庫僅實現作為補充材料提供。
